title: Rust: Encryption and Hashing
description: Implement basic encryption, hashing, and cryptographic operations in Rust.

steps.title: Caesar Cipher
steps.description: Implement a Caesar cipher: `encrypt(text: &str, shift: u8) -> String` that shifts each letter by `shift` positions. Test with `"abc"` shifted by 3.
hints: Iterate over chars, shift only alphabetic characters.
Wrap around: `((c - b'a' + shift) % 26 + b'a')` for lowercase.

steps.title: Decrypt Caesar Cipher
steps.description: Implement a `decrypt` function. Decrypt `"khoor"` (which was encrypted with shift 3) and print the result.
hints: Decrypt by shifting backwards: `(c - b'a' - shift + 26) % 26`

steps.title: Vigenère Cipher
steps.description: Implement a Vigenère cipher using a keyword key. Encrypt `"rustlang"` with key `"key"` and print the result.
hints: Use each letter of the key to shift the corresponding plaintext letter.

verification.failureMessage: Encrypt 'rustlang' with key 'key' and print the ciphertext.

steps.title: Base64 Encoding (Manual)
steps.description: Implement a simple encoding scheme: convert each byte to a 2-digit hex string. Encode `"Hello"` and print the hex representation.

steps.title: SHA-256 Simulation
steps.description: Implement a simple checksum (not real SHA-256): sum all bytes and return as hex. Hash `"Rust"` and print. While not cryptographically secure, it demonstrates the concept.
hints: `let sum: u32 = text.bytes().map(|b| b as u32).sum();`
Simple hash: not secure, just demonstrates the concept.

verification.failureMessage: Compute and print a checksum for 'Rust'.
